Scope: Local generation of the DP original-route resource manifest
Observed: An initial inline generator wrote the sbatch scripts but raised NameError because json was not imported before publishing the manifest. Mechanical prepare refused the missing manifest; no remote command or submission occurred.
Cause: Inline manifest generator omitted an explicit json import.
Correction: Use a named reproducible generator with explicit imports and atomic manifest publication. Execute it before prepare; keep the checked submit gate.
GeneralLesson: Generate submission inputs reproducibly and atomically. A missing or partial resource manifest must prevent submission rather than triggering a fallback submit.
Validation: Named generator executed successfully, prepare returned pass with its regression suite. Real collector dynamic-dispatch regression and actual vacuum two-stage entry both pass. No numerical retry was needed for this metadata failure.
